name: Temporary Enemy
body:
You briefly treat a creature as your nemesis.

Prerequisite(s): favored enemy class feature, ranger level 5th.

Benefit(s): Once per day as a swift action, you can designate one creature you can see as your favored enemy for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Make a Knowledge check to identify the creature. If you succeed, you use your highest favored enemy bonus against them; otherwise, your bonus is +2.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
